configuration: Numerical derivatives; float64 output, SAB_REPEATS=1, fixed deterministic geometry, and the parameters documented in runner.py.
observable: Finite-difference derivative tensors and paired SOAP features for averaging and compression configurations.
default_vs_upstream: Adapted from the corresponding official test into a self-contained deterministic numerical observable; breadth is retained while redundant parametrizations are reduced.
variant: ic/variant changes one active binary64 input value from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004 (two ulps); the value perturbs a coordinate or, for radial orthonormality, r_cut.
altbuild: none: the initial Debian image intentionally carries one GCC build; cross-build numerical floors will be represented by calibration evidence when available.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative-build floor is available; finite differencing amplified the Docker nominal/variant perturbation to a measured 2.665e-11 spread.

warrant: The physically indexed finite-difference derivative tensors and paired SOAP features are compared pointwise at atol=1e-6 and rtol=5e-4, following the pinned upstream derivative comparisons and allowing finite-difference cancellation across valid implementations. The measured Docker perturbation spread is 2.665e-11, while displacement, atom/center-axis, compression, or descriptor faults alter tensor entries well beyond the approved bound.
